colors: Bare PCBA: black solder mask with white silkscreen ('CM01'), yellow XT30 connectors (SuperCap and PwrCtrl ports), white 4-pin GH (SM04B-GHS-TB) CAN/power port, small SMD parts; the current official photo shows it inside a clear protective sleeve.
